FULL TEXT:
HARCOURT BUTLER TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY, KANPUR
CORRIGENDUM to the Recruitment Advertisement Published in “AMAR UJALA” New
paper on 25.10.2026
This corrigendum is in reference to Advertisement No. File No. 1460/HBTU/Estt./01/2026 dated
24.10.2026 for the faculty and administrative positions in the university published in the “Amar
Ujala” Newspaper (only) on October 25th 2026. The following amendments be read in the
advertisement published in Amar Ujala:
a) Because of inadvertent typographical error by the publisher, 1 post each of Professor
(UR) and Associate Professor (EWS) were published in Mechanical Engineering
Department. The same may please be ignored. In fact, there is only 01 (one) post of
Associate Professor (OBC) in Mechanical Engineering.
b) The post of Associate Professor in Humanities is for Economics Discipline. Thus, the
Department/discipline be read as Humanities (Economics).
All other positions and notes in the said Advertisement in “Amar Ujala” remain
the same.
Note: The said Advertisement published in rest of the Newspapers (The Hindustan Times dated
27.10.2026; Hindustan (Hindi) dated 27.10.2026; The Times of India- ASCENT dated
28.10.2026) is correct.
(Registrar)
